noClub.title: Play with others
noClub.subtitle: Join a club and play matches with players nearby
noClub.stepsBody1: Give it a name, abbreviation, and country. Your club gets a unique 5-character code — send it to friends so they can join.
noClub.stepsBody2: Create 2v2, 3v3, or 5v5 meetups in your area. Other clubs respond to the challenge and fill the open slots.
noClub.stepsBody3: Matches and activity translate into league points. The weekly ranking resets every Monday at 00:00.
